title: Conditional κ = 0.001635527380375392: coordinated owner repair on PR623
body:
This reassigns whole helpers in PR623's fixed 64 JP8 / 8 CK dispatch, raising conditional κ from 0.001635490664920455 to **0.001635527380375392** (`51110230636731/31250000000000000`). The exact gain is `36715454937/10^18`. All R492 supplier words, construction code, recipes, verifier, controller, invoice and assembly engines remain byte-identical to PR623/PR622.

The idle profile changes from `{1:122,2:1,3:1,12:1,21:1,48:2215}` to `{1:123,37:1,48:2215}`. A bounded search nominated the map; failed aggregate nominations were repaired with cross-time Hall cuts, and the final literal allocation passed unchanged independent admission. No solver objective or floating optimality status is used as a certificate.

Verification: the final portable package passed **64 fresh stages on macOS and Linux**, each with **51 receipt artifacts**, without baseline or native-receipt reuse. Every artifact and all 128 stage logs were hash-checked. A separate checker reconstructs actual native widths, physical ownership, timing, disjoint footprints, rank mass and exact rational moments. Its certificate matches across platforms. Supplemental checks pass two positive controls and reject eight corrupt inputs under `-I -O`.

Run `bash research/complex-k492-owner-repair/verify.sh /tmp/k492-replay`. All six pinned source packages are bundled. `complex-k492-owner-repair-validation` contains raw logs, receipts, exact source review and search provenance. The added workflow runs the complete replay on Python 3.11 and 3.14; GitHub CI is pending at publication.

The result retains the inherited compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape/exact recovery, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 assumptions. It is a finite conditional witness, not an unconditional theorem, κ=1, a complete Lean proof, a packing optimum or a practical speedup.

Credits: jeremykothe2 and Claude Opus for PR623/PR622; GamingPuzzled for PR620's owner-map lead; DreamingOfClouds and earlier supplier contributors listed in the preserved NOTICE. This continuation, portable packaging and independent checks were prepared by OpenAI Codex for chafreaky. Historical `cand.json` and `data/search/` remain clearly labeled PR623 provenance. No priority claim.
